title: Wellfleet Harbor Seal Cruise Small Group Boat Tour on Cape Cod
includes: All safety equipment and life jackets
Wildlife viewing in Cape Cod Bay
Food and drinks (you're welcome to bring your own) (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Are there any children under age 12 in your group? If yes, please provide each child’s height, weight, and age in the Special Requirements section so we can provide a properly fitted life jacket.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy a private seal-watching crossing with only your group aboard. We’ll explore at a relaxed pace, with time to linger when conditions allow and observe gray and harbor seals from a respectful distance. Each trip is shaped by the tide, weather, and wildlife, making every outing a little different. A great choice for families, photographers, and anyone looking for a quieter, more personal experience on the water. Up to 6 passengers.
